name: Adit
source: Adit is a high school student who has a special ability to turn back time. It is not known how Adit can get that ability. Adit has long harbored feelings for Lala. With his ability to turn back time, he succeeded in inventing his crush, though he had to go through a long and repetitive struggle because Lala was a very sensitive and easily prejudiced woman.
